scope: Substantive refresh of an existing seasonal post at its URL, adding sources

observations.summary: IBHS (insurance research institute and FORTIFIED standards body): inspect washer hoses regularly, replace every 3 to 5 years, upgrade to braided stainless steel; inspect water heaters every 6 months, flush for sediment, replace after 7 to 10 years depending on water quality and usage; stop toilet overflows by lifting the float or shutting off the valve; know the main shut-off and turn it off when traveling.
Only human waste and toilet paper in the toilet; a leaky or running toilet can waste up to 200 gallons per day; spread laundry across days on septic.
observations.inference_limit: Septic guidance applied to toilet habits generally.

observations.summary: Removed an unsourced 10-year water heater upgrade rule, a 'fast, reliable' service claim and a templated what-to-expect FAQ; added quick answer, travel and septic sections, links to related posts and a sources section. Original date kept, updated added.
